payload.rationale: The revised positive plane is entirely execution-oriented: Samsung reports actual HBM4 mass-production shipments, AMD confirms realized HBM3E supply history, and 2026Q1 memory revenue and ASP are actual rather than forecast. Those facts support a conditional rerating direction when compared with forward consolidated PE 5.59x and PB 2.99x. The score remains moderate because those multiples use projected company-wide denominators, while trailing and cash-based measures are less favorable and no supplied fact bridges the actual HBM or memory execution to period-matched HBM earnings or free cash flow.
payload.why_not_higher: There is no HBM-specific revenue, margin, CAPEX, or FCF denominator; NVIDIA supply remains a plan under discussion, and trailing PE/PB plus forward EV/EBITDA and FCF yield constrain the optimistic forward PE/PB interpretation.
payload.why_not_lower: The operating delta is not hypothetical: actual memory revenue, realized ASP expansion, actual HBM4 shipments, and AMD-confirmed HBM3E supply provide source-backed execution that is stronger than a forecast-only rerating case.
